description: This file defines an extension method for ISiloBuilder to configure an in-memory lease provider used in Orleans runtime development scenarios. It adds a transient service registration for ILeaseProvider with InMemoryLeaseProvider.

classes.name: DevelopmentSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for ISiloBuilder to add development-specific configurations like in-memory lease provider.

methods.name: UseInMemoryLeaseProvider
methods.description: Extension method for ISiloBuilder to configure it with an in-memory lease provider for development and testing purposes.
